clue.text: Reverberating hair curlers?

parts.note: read playfully as the undulations that set a thick mop of hair curling, it also describes the pressure fronts that echo out from a blast

explanation.surface: A question about curlers that make a head of hair ring or echo.
explanation.walkthrough: A shock is a thick mass of hair and waves are curls set in it, so curlers might produce them; the real phrase is the pulse of pressure spreading from an explosion.
explanation.definitionFit: Pressure fronts radiating out from an explosion or impact reverberate through air and ground.

clue.text: Give cheek in America when boarding ship

indicators.note: boarding a vessel means getting inside it, so one word goes within the letters for the ship

parts.note: SS is the abbreviation for steamship
as can mean when, as in 'as I left'

explanation.surface: Someone is told off for answering back on a US-bound vessel.
explanation.definitionFit: American slang for answering back insolently, a variant of saucy talk.

clue.text: No back chat, all right!

parts.note: O is nought, nothing, standing for no

indicators.note: back here tells you the word for chat is read from right to left

parts.note: yak is informal for chat

explanation.surface: A parent shuts down an argument: no answering back, fine!
explanation.walkthrough: 'back' turns YAK into KAY, placed after O; 'No back chat' reads as one stern phrase but splits after 'No'.
explanation.definitionFit: An exclamation of agreement or assent, a spelt-out form of OK.

clue.text: Retain article on exercises — one to avoid hostilities

parts.note: to retain is to keep
the is the definite article
PE is physical education, school exercises
an ace is a one in a pack of cards

explanation.surface: Instructions to hold onto an item while doing drills, then a figure who prevents fighting.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom for refraining from violence and maintaining public order.

clue.text: An affliction of the heart

parts.note: an gives the indefinite article A
a trial is a burden or affliction

explanation.surface: A romantic sorrow described as a malady of the heart.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface reads as heartache, but 'of the heart' is the adjectival definition: the atria are the upper heart chambers.
explanation.definitionFit: Relating to the atria, the upper chambers of the cardiac muscle.

clue.text: Compelled to be for the church in the final

indicators.note: in means these letters sit inside the word for the final

parts.note: the final part of something is its end
taken as written
CE is the Church of England

explanation.surface: A team forced to play for a church side in a cup final.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: something compelled is imposed or made obligatory by force.

clue.text: See the difficulty

definitions.meaning: a ... is a tight situation, as in being in a ...

explanation.surface: Someone points out where the problem lies.
explanation.definitionFit: Noticing something and a tight predicament, as in being in a tricky corner.

clue.text: Do they account for the growth in gliders?

definitions.text: Do they account for the growth in gliders?

parts.words: Do they account for the growth in gliders?
parts.note: gliders are aircraft, so growth among aircraft suggests a crop of them, while the real answer is a type of tall city tree

explanation.surface: A question about why more gliders are appearing.
explanation.walkthrough: Gliders are planes, so trees of planes might be where planes grow; the answer is the London plane, a common street tree.
explanation.definitionFit: Tall broad-leaved trees of the genus Platanus often lining city streets.

clue.text: Travellers who earn stints working

indicators.note: working here means the letters are put to work in a new order

explanation.surface: People on the move who take short jobs to earn money.
explanation.walkthrough: 'working' rearranges the letters of EARN STINTS.
explanation.definitionFit: People passing through, staying only briefly, such as itinerant workers.

clue.text: The skill required to put on Showboat

definitions.text: The skill required to put on Showboat

parts.words: The skill required to put on Showboat
parts.note: staging a musical like Showboat needs theatrical know-how, and the word also splits as stage (put on) plus a boat (vessel)

explanation.surface: What it takes to mount the musical Showboat.
explanation.walkthrough: To put on is to stage, and a boat is a craft, so the musical's title hides the two halves of the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Theatrical expertise in mounting productions.

clue.text: Delay returning to a sporting occasion

indicators.note: returning means the word for delay comes back on itself, read backwards

parts.note: lag is a delay

explanation.surface: A postponement before a big sports meet.
explanation.walkthrough: 'returning' turns LAG into GAL, then A is added.
explanation.definitionFit: A festive event, especially a swimming meeting or sports festival.

clue.text: Dish that might appeal to bush, perhaps?

indicators.note: perhaps suggests the letters might form these words, read as a loose rearrangement

explanation.surface: A dish a President Bush might like, a political joke.
explanation.walkthrough: 'perhaps' rearranges APPEAL TO BUSH; aptly the dish has letter-shaped pasta that could spell out those words.
explanation.definitionFit: A soup containing pasta shaped like letters.

clue.text: Restore small model vehicles

indicators.note: model means the letters are shaped into a different form

explanation.surface: Fix up miniature toy cars.
explanation.walkthrough: 'model' rearranges RESTORE SMALL; the surface suggests model vehicles, but 'model' is a verb on the letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Heavy road-building machines that flatten surfaces are vehicles.

clue.text: A little money plus good fortune goes to one's head but gives one courage

parts.note: P is a penny, a small coin
luck is good fortune
one is the numeral I
a ness is a headland, a head of land

explanation.surface: Money and luck go to someone's head but make them brave.
explanation.walkthrough: 'head' is not the top of a person but a headland, NESS, as in Loch Ness or Sheerness.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: spirited bravery, the quality of being plucky.

clue.text: How one gets into big band music?

definitions.text: How one gets into big band music?

parts.words: How one gets into big band music?
parts.note: big band music is swing, so entering it suggests going through doors, the real answer being doors that open both ways

explanation.surface: A question about how to start enjoying big band jazz.
explanation.walkthrough: Swing is big band jazz, so the way into it is via its doors; the real thing is a door hung to open either way.
explanation.definitionFit: Doors on hinges that let them open in either direction and close by themselves.

clue.text: Bass clef, but understated

definitions.meaning: a bass clef marks music in a deep register

explanation.surface: A musician compares a deep clef with a subdued manner.
explanation.definitionFit: A deep musical pitch, and restrained or subdued in style.

clue.text: Shoes are designed for life, in the main

indicators.note: designed means the letters are worked into a new pattern

explanation.surface: Footwear made to last a lifetime, for the most part.
explanation.walkthrough: 'designed' rearranges SHOES ARE; 'in the main' looks like 'mostly' but means in the sea, the main.
explanation.definitionFit: A small fish found in the sea, and the main is a poetic word for the sea.

clue.text: A diamond one held in November?

definitions.meaning: slang for a gem, especially a diamond
a handheld firework waved on Bonfire Night, 5 November in Britain

explanation.surface: A diamond held aloft in November.
explanation.walkthrough: Bonfire Night, 5 November, is the British fireworks night when children wave handheld fireworks.
explanation.definitionFit: Slang for a gem that glitters, and a handheld firework that spits sparks.

clue.text: Lack of respect from team leader following Tory office worker

indicators.note: following says the team's leading letter comes after the other pieces

parts.note: Con is short for Conservative, a Tory
a temp is a temporary office worker

indicators.note: leader means the opening letter of the word team

explanation.surface: A team captain shows disdain for a Conservative office assistant.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: scorn or disdain.

clue.text: Missing broadcast by a bishop

parts.note: B is the chess abbreviation for bishop
sent can mean transmitted or broadcast

explanation.surface: A bishop fails to appear in a broadcast.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: not present.

clue.text: One with bearing — lean and mean

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one
N, north, is a compass bearing
to tend is to lean or incline

explanation.surface: Someone with a demeanour that is thin and nasty.
explanation.walkthrough: 'lean and mean' looks like a description of a tough person, but 'lean' gives TEND and 'mean' is the verb definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to have in mind as a purpose.

clue.text: Not a credit — in poor condition

indicators.note: poor means the letters are in a bad state and need rearranging

explanation.surface: A remark that a person or thing is a disgrace and in bad shape.
explanation.walkthrough: 'poor' rearranges NOT A CREDIT IN; 'condition' is a verb, to train someone's thinking.
explanation.definitionFit: To condition someone's mind is to instil beliefs uncritically.

clue.text: Talk of escape from bloodsucker

indicators.note: talk of means the word is spoken, said aloud

parts.note: flee means escape

explanation.surface: Discussing a getaway from a blood-sucking parasite.
explanation.definitionFit: A tiny jumping insect that feeds on blood.

clue.text: Genuine regret follows troubled start

indicators.note: follows puts the word for regret after that first letter
start means the opening letter of troubled

parts.note: to rue is to regret

explanation.surface: Real remorse after a difficult beginning.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: real or authentic.

clue.text: A manifestation of love from the queen to old bob

parts.note: ER is Elizabeth Regina, the queen
a bob is a shilling, abbreviated s, in old British money

explanation.surface: A token of affection from the monarch to an old shilling.
explanation.walkthrough: A bob was a shilling in pre-decimal British money, written s.
explanation.definitionFit: The Greek god of desire personifies romantic passion.

clue.text: Depressed, prior to arrest of the workers

indicators.note: prior to places the word for depressed before the next piece

parts.note: feeling blue is feeling depressed
to collar is to arrest

explanation.surface: Feeling low before the workers are arrested.
explanation.definitionFit: Describing manual labourers, as opposed to office staff.

clue.text: Band that has played on Sunday

indicators.note: on means the shuffled piece comes after the abbreviation, joined on
played means the letters of has are rearranged

explanation.surface: A band that performed at the weekend.
explanation.walkthrough: 'played' turns HAS into ASH, placed on after S.
explanation.definitionFit: A strip of cloth worn over the shoulder or round the waist.

clue.text: Deal with Sheffield's car numbers

parts.note: to deal is to trade
Sheffield plate is silver-coated copper, famous from that city

explanation.surface: A deal involving car registration numbers from Sheffield.
explanation.walkthrough: Sheffield plate is copper fused with silver, made in Sheffield; trade plates are temporary number plates used by motor dealers.
explanation.definitionFit: Temporary registration markers that motor traders fix to unregistered cars.
